_purpose: A build profile for the Harness: how a Godot project builds and what it yields. A Godot game is a mini-app (one index.html with the game's pack inside, the shared engine in ./libs/) plus native builds kept as downloads. mChatAI+ reads this generically; no Godot names live in Swift. See README.md and docs/GODOT_LANE_PLAN.md section 11 in mchatai_macOS.

tool.installHint: Godot 4.7.2 with its export templates (Editor > Manage Export Templates), and `godot` on the PATH

devices.why: Godot games are built for a mouse or a large touch screen; a phone layout is a separate design
